title: Before You Scroll, Pray This for Peace
hook: Before you scroll, give God the next 20 seconds.
script: Before you scroll, give God the next 20 seconds. Father, You see the worry I am carrying. Your Word tells us to bring everything to You in prayer. So I give You what I cannot control. Quiet my mind. Steady my heart. Fill me with the peace that comes from You. Help me trust You with today and leave tomorrow in Your hands. In Jesus' name, amen.
